_comment: S-06: mutation testing scoped to the anomaly detection correctness core (pure detectors + risk score + suggested-action templates). Runs the DB-free unit project via the vitest runner; the typescript checker discards mutants that don't compile. `break` fails CI when the mutation score drops below threshold. S-28 impl-review F7: `day-bucket.ts` joins the glob. `working-time.ts` was deliberately placed under `rules/` so mutation would cover it, then delegated its hardest arithmetic — the binary search for a local wall-clock hour, which is what makes the clock right across DST — to `day-bucket.ts`, which was outside. The reasoning that moved the primitive applies to the function doing the work.
